notes.title: Fat[EX] Courier Simulator - Devlog #84 "Instructions unclear?!"
notes.content:
Hello Couriers! 

What to do if there was a mixup of sorts at your job and you have very unclear directions?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/c529db49e8fc295f555515db63988b0a38ff95c2.png

While we were making improvements to the suburbs neighbourhood area that you will sometimes visit during your activities as a courier we've suddenly realized how difficult would it be to deliver a package when instructions are not clearly and precisely formulated. It's a scary thought, right? You have a package that you need to deliver today but you're not sure which of the buildings is the one belonging to your customer!

For example - imagine having such "clues" as for choosing the right building - there is a car to the side of the building and the person living in the house is from North America. Would you be able to risk the right answer with only those two clues? A true courier has to be very perceptive and notice all the details of the area! 

Thank you for checking in with us - see you in our next devlog!

Best regards,
Fat[EX] Courier Simulator Team

notes.title: Fat[EX] Courier Simulator - Devlog #83 "Difficult ways can be crossed too!"
notes.content:
Hello Couriers! 

What to do when the road ends and your objective requires you to drive further?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/d96993ab75f4123b61b32f45d44a142f52a3cf4b.png

Well, technically speaking you might have two choices in that kind of situation - either leave your truck behind and walk the rest of the distance or try to force your way through the off-road situation! Of course even those limited options might get thinner if you have several packages to deliver - unless you're okay with walking the very same distance several times in a row. Usually then the decision might be to... drive your trusty sidekick despite the difficulties of terrain! 

It will be an adventure - definitely! Bumpy paths, difficult curves and smell of the dirt in the air - that's something our courier will have to get quickly accustomed to as they deliver their packages. Your abilities as a driver will also be tested - you definitely don't want to hit a bad spot on the road and wreck your machine. Being stranded out there might be a bit scary...   

Thank you for checking in with us - see you in our next devlog!

Best regards,
Fat[EX] Courier Simulator Team

notes.title: Fat[EX] Courier Simulator - Devlog #81 "The nature is calling!"

What will be behind that curve or slope? These kind of questions might create your own vision for your courier. Away from the city hustle and bustle he simply might want to enjoy a moment of piece by the near forest. And we know - he deserves it! 

Thank you for checking in with us - see you in our next devlog!

notes.title: Fat[EX] Courier Simulator - Devlog #80 "On the road!"
notes.content:
Hello Couriers! 

Much of the time in game you will spend behind a wheel of your trusty truck!

And while driving itself can be quite a pleasure - and we'll do our best to ensure that it's exactly the case with our game - sometimes it's also nice to check out the environment that we are smoothly passing while shifting to a next gear. The beautiful view of the mountains might be obstructed by the acoustic screens but we'll definitely have a chance to see more of them in future!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/dc121398d1613b4532bf924775693286d00d6b41.png

We're gradually updating and enhancing the environment of the city but also of the areas outside. We want the city to look visually pleasing but we are also thinking about sensible technical solutions that are realistic - for example the acoustic screens simply make sense to be placed in the areas where noise levels are surpassing a certain level - like close to the factories or heavy work areas. As that is the case designing them and "equipping" our city with those is a given! Effects of similar decisions that we are making you'll be able to see as you play through the game - and we certainly hope you will take some time (from time to time) to simply check the area!

notes.title: Fat[EX] Courier Simulator - Devlog #79 "Delivery to factory!"
notes.content:
Hello Couriers! 

Individual customers are one thing but what about potential deliveries for factories?

Working as a courier does not mean that you will only deliver your packages to singular customers. Sometimes your services might be needed in a very particular place - a shop, office or a factory. In this particular example our courier has to visit a factory site - perhaps to deliver some necessary materials without which this particular company simply cannot go on! As always it is us who will save them from this peril - no factory wants to stop the production only because they run out of materials. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/dd3356e16f5731924709afa4975d85852bf46c37.png

What do you think - what kind of quests, missions or deliveries our courier might go through at this particular site? Will he have to be particularly cautious and worry about any tools falling over from heights? Will he need some particular clothing to enter the factory? And - isn't it fun to wonder what kind of factory it is? Perhaps it's a chocolate factory... who knows? Let's make sure our hero fulfill his tasks properly and without any hitches! 

Thank you for checking in with us - see you in our next devlog!

Best regards,
Fat[EX] Courier Simulator Team

Break is over - we're back with further changes for our game! This time we look at game menu!

notes.content:
Hello Couriers! 

With so many changes happening during last few weeks we feel that our courier deserves a little break...

Have you ever wondered what is our courier doing after his shift is over? Or... whether he ever ends his shift? Perhaps he is constantly at work, always making sure that the deliveries are going smoothly and without a hitch? While we believe that he would be more than capable of doing so we still think that he needs to catch a breather from time to time. Just... destress, refuel his energy tanks and then come back at it with triple the usual power!   

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/81698f1185d59b6e114f74d329689147aec29d84.png

The truck neatly parked next to the door signifies that he is finally getting his well-deserved rest. Perhaps after a short nap he will then go to the park for a short stroll or to a nearby cafe to grab himself some coffee? On his free time he is after all allowed to do anything he wants! What do you think our courier is doing after his job? As we do our best to enhance the game graphically we believe that he will have many different areas to visit and recuperate! And what is more - in future you can expect more place to visit and explore! 

After all as we said previously - the city always changes! 

Let us know about your ideas for the way our courier can rest - he might use some of them!

notes.title: Fat[EX] Courier Simulator - Devlog #69 "Truck Revolution!"
notes.content:
Hello Couriers! 

Not so long ago we've had the pleasure to show you our refreshed courier... but wait, there's more!

You know how it is - a knight can be skilled and dedicated to his job but it's their trusty stead that will bring them to their destination. As that is the case we know that we cannot simply improve one element of this combo without the other. A knight's armour received some polish, let's do the same for his mount!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/b5e283813d4cebc12f9a4d6341830bbbe69dc83b.png

Our truck has never looked better, I'd say! Look at the mighty logo it display on its side, look at the tires and lights! The visualization of the truck you can see above and below is the greatest showcase of what we intend to do with the ride. We want it to feel safe but at the same deserving proper respect and invoking in you the feeling of riding in a classy drive. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/00460ba15b56d8709e48415cca756b2b7d6921f0.png

It will be safer, it will be faster and it will be more reliable than our old truck, we're completely sure of it. But we are also very interested in your opinion! How do you like our renewed truck and the visualization we've prepared for it? We're all ears (or, in this case, eyes)! 

Thank you for checking in with us this week and see you next time!

notes.title: Fat[EX] Courier Simulator - Devlog #68 "That's not how you park!"
notes.content:
Hello Couriers! 

Sometimes you will be hard pressed to find a parking spot but that does not mean that you should not pay attention and break the law without a care in the world!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/40de98d183264a859041aa108bf3a49e92134c68.png

Let's start with the easiest example - what you see on the screenshot above is absolutely unacceptable! Expect a Police to haul you car away and get a big fine if you park your truck like that. Middle of the street is not the place to park your car and that does not change even if the street is remote one or very rarely used. You need to find a proper parking spot if you want to deliver your packages to a house nearby!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/8f444c0aab64957f4a712b71d9512cb2d77c17f3.png

It is also completely unreasonable and not permissible to park on the estate of the customers - especially so if they were not contacted about it previously. You might cause damage to the property and you and your company will have to face fines that might be really high. You definitely don't want to lose your job over a moment of weakness and laziness! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/69936565f464d8484ff16b153445d0e91b28b9cb.png

Additionally - you cannot park in any green spot you see. Those are most likely private properties and if you park there you risk getting another fine or at least warning. Besides it's simply rude to drive over a land owned by someone else. Perhaps they are cultivating some vegetable there or a construction will start on the land in next 15 minutes? With your truck parked there... well, it would be a true catastrophe! 

Thank you for checking in with us this week and see you next time!

Best regards,
Fat[EX] Courier Simulator Team

notes.title: Fat[EX] Courier Simulator - Devlog #63 "Achievement survey results!"
notes.content:
Hello Couriers! 

Thank you for filling out the achievement survey from our last devlog!

We're happy to see you engaged in our activities and to see your opinion about the achievement systems. We've received many answers for the questions we asked last time and we're happy to share some of the answers to our survey. What is more - we've received many messages of encouragement and positive feedback and we are absolutely thrilled to hear that! Thank you very much for your kind words!

Interestingly enough fans of our project are split almost evenly among fans of achievements and players who don't really care that much about that particular feature of the game. What it does tell us is that even though most of you don't necessarily dislike the achievement system we would be wise to make the system within which achievements would be more subtle. This is something that we will definitely consider when working on this particular feature of the game. Those of you in favour of the achievements said that they give you a goal to work for - which in itself is an important thing to consider. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/6034ecfbe529306a73700cddc81a8c48195c6374.png

As it turns out - some of you tend to decide on playing the game in relation to game having an achievement system or not. notes.title: Fat[EX] Courier Simulator - Devlog #61 "Package status?"
notes.content:
Hello Couriers! 

Your package is the most important item - guard it with your all might!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/670789d3c373a884377caeb694fc04e882c161d9.png

State of the package your are delivering to your customers is very important. After all if it's completely tattered, dirty and whatever is inside seems to be broken no-one will accept that kind of parcel. Customers might file a complaint and the company that used your services might refuse to ever work with you again! Of course, sometimes bad things happen but if the start to happen repeatedly... 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/37475cb124edf68aa0a069d6840799b0546138d3.png

Take a look at the package above. Notice 4 colourful squares? In our game those will represent "lifepoints" of our package. Package might lose lifepoints whenever something dangerous happens to it. For example, if you have the idea to throw the package over the fence you cannot expect that it will stay in the completely same state it was before that fantastic thought came to your mind! Package might lose healthpoint in a variety of situations. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/791a5bd770a41e920c5094a59e32526598c8023f.png

Now we're down to one last health point - we need to be extra careful with its delivery. Anything bad happens to it and it might turn ugly really quick. Make sure to handle the package very thoughtfully and carefully. Perhaps maybe deliver it by hand? If you put it in the storage area of your truck you still might risk that something will happen to it during the ride... ah, it's very problematic now!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/9df3cdcb7aeafe89d9fc686c71e525d705169e47.png

However if you fail one more time... it's the screen above that you will have to meet in your playthrough. Losing 4 points means that package is in a state that is unacceptable and you simply need not to deliver it anymore - it will not be accepted anyway.

Let's try to avoid those kind of situations!

Best regards,
Fat[EX] Courier Simulator Team

notes.title: Fat[EX] Courier Simulator - Devlog #59 "What is a courier without his truck?"

Hello Couriers! 

We've noticed that we've never quite talked about your most important asset as a courier - your truck!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/3b7cbf788c0ab7e690201a4ee51ddc2bb1854c25.png

On your own leg? Or perhaps a little bit better but still unironically strange - by going there on a bus? No way! Your truck is your status symbol - you need to drive in order to feel complete as a delivery guy. You need to be proud of your truck. It's your greatest ally! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/5f2a6a9af0dea63d596ec3ddc16273d05ec3d6fe.png

And your truck is great. It's quite fast - but not too fast so you won't get in trouble with Police. It's versatile, it can drive on almost any surface and it has quite a spacious storage space so you can take many packages with you at once and don't have to worry about coming back for extra deliveries. It also has those three interesting buttons on its side... 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/dbb2ede48e81290e4ddf80ace8f643a1f9e1ba89.png

By pressing one of them the hatch will open and you will be able to load your truck. Just a press of a button - isn't that convenient? But wait, that's not all... 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/71050768189d377cc6052083f083343e72f9272e.png

Two other buttons control the lift so you can load your packages in an easier way. You don't have to throw your deliveries and risk them become damaged - you can instead use the technology to make your life easier. And it's all thanks to truck. 

Make sure to respect your truck - it does its best to help you!

notes.title: Fat[EX] Courier Simulator - Devlog #55 "Beware the traffic!"
notes.content:
Hello Couriers! 

Couriers have to face challenges every day! One the biggest one is... facing other drivers!

Quite honestly, if everyone vigilantly focused on the law and abide by the rules couriers job might have been so much easier. Unfortunately - that does not always happen, although we are far from making any generalizations in that regard. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/91c45b502f73ee0a6ab08688fbe88f5d26900a9f.png

Take care of yourself and of the others on the road!

notes.title: Fat[EX] Courier Simulator - Devlog #54 "Contactless Delivery"
notes.content:
Hello Couriers! 

Times are changing and something that used to be quite atypical in past is a standard nowadays!

Contactless delivery has become very important in contemporary times and couriers had to adapt to new reality where very often they don't even get to see their client's face! Of course our courier is not an exception and he is also following the newest trends and regulations. Let's check with him during one of the deliveries!  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/8c1e64bfa4c972eeeba147da91bc21f2c8b643c3.png

A moment of choice for every single courier out there - do you try to make it by going through closed road that you know is faster and still quite acceptable to drive on or do you follow the rules and go around the closed route? Customer is waiting and clock is ticking...

notes.title: Fat[EX] Courier Simulator - Devlog #53 "City Areas #2"
notes.content:
Hello Couriers! 

New Year, New Me but deliveries still need to happen! Let's take a look at other important areas of the city and vicinity of the game!
 
This time we are starting with the... forest! Yes, it's not quite sensible to say that forest is an integral area of the city but in case of our place it does have some degree of sense. You'll quite often have to go through the forest in order to deliver the packages from your office into the more remote areas of the game map. Forest can be quiet and relaxing place but you still need to look out for the possibility of animals going on the street in an unexpected manner. No worries however - just have your eyes open and stick to the road. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/6dcf2300fc8feb2b203e48b71adfe6a95716dece.png

It pays off to find a moment to take a breather here while looking at the slowly but steadily flowing river. Some of the citizens tend to find themselves here when looking for a place that would allow their thoughts and minds to drift. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/5107d9fadae558ad5d77550a125cb857fcbf910a.png

What you need to remember is that city is a living being, in a way. It always finds it way to grow and to change. That means that you might expect some areas that we haven't talked about too much yet and that we will definitely cover in future devlogs!

Happy New Year everybody - thank you for supporting us up until now!

notes.title: Fat[EX] Courier Simulator - Devlog #52 "City Areas #1"
notes.content:
Hello Couriers! 

We’ve spent the last devlog talking about curious and interesting places in the city. This time let’s take a wider look and let’s see what areas we will find in the game!
 
Let’s start with the area that will be the very first one you will have an opportunity to visit when starting the game - the residential area. That is the place specifically designed for people to live, relax and breathe, a place where rest is the most important thing. You will find many blocks, houses, cafes and boulevards here - all created to make sure that people living in the city can live in the most comfortable way. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/9561b0a97a185b0ccc5355e45c8a71340c05b55f.png

Next one on the list is the urban area of the city. Here is the place where most people in the city work. Full of skyscrapers and offices, classy and well-designed, a lot of people dream of working at this particular place. While it’s mostly administrational work, it is still constructed in a way to cater to all of the workers and employees fulfilling their duties. You will also find a lot of shops and restaurants here so you can go on a break and enjoy a bite. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/ab47239ef08f5bd097691498122d7c4c4f36ea64.png

To complete the first part of our overview of different areas of the city we would like to present you the industrial part of the city. In order to not bother people living in the main part of the city the industrial part has been moved to a side. Here is the place where most of the factories are constructed and where all the heavy work happens. It can get a little bit noisy here but it is the place where most of the needed work is taking place. Heavy factories, high chimneys, many delivery trucks and cargo cars - those are all the everyday element of the place. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/c4e4b8d56efab7fd2e7667dddb4ee76fde0c29a2.png

That’s not all the city has to offer - make sure to follow us as we still have few places to discover and talk about! 

Would you like to live in a city like the one in the game?

Fat[EX] Courier Simulator Team

One of the very important game mechanics that you will be able to use in the game is the ability to… creatively handle the packages. Or simply said - to throw stuff around!

Take it or throw it - decision is yours!

notes.title: Fat[EX] Courier Simulator - Devlog #47 "Mistakes were made…"
notes.content:
Hello Couriers! 

Once in a while we all make mistakes… but somehow it is so much painful if it’s a mistake that happened to a courier that was supposed to bring our package today, right?.

There are several types of mistake that a courier needs to be aware of to not repeat them and after thinking about it for a while we decided to list them up for you so they will work as a kind of warning for you to always be careful!
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/48bd626d25995314e0e210313589126a8481ed8c.png

A courier should definitely never mistake an order. It’s enough to imagine the disappointment of a customer waiting for his package when they discover that it’s not what their ordered. It’s even more painful when the orders are visibly different in size as the mistake is even more pronounced then!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/ae9e1fd80e8001aafbf42824b087478afeb99715.png

Destroying or damaging a package is a big no-no! We would say that is the worst thing that can happen to a courier and if it’s their fault that it was destroyed it’s really difficult to explain to the devastated or angry customer the situation. Make sure to be careful when handling their orders!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/7c3b1e6956a6884727694a9fe381051b15f93a06.png

Never forget about properly securing your cargo. If it falls out of your truck because you forgot to close the hatch or doors… well, be prepared for some very uncomfortable and stressful consequences…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/5473515f18d6abbbd0ffc9105e192de334629b24.png

Always remember the size of your track. There will be some passages where you will be unable to go through and if you try you will get stuck. The same goes for the gate in your own garage – always open it properly or you will most likely have a very costly accident!
Can you think of any other mistakes that courier can make?

Best regards,
Fat[EX] Courier Simulator Team

Hello Couriers! 

Many of most likely know that annoying feeling when you’re trying to find a parking spot and suddenly all seem to be taken except this single one that is just so narrow…

Being a courier means being a driver. You and your truck are a combo that cannot be separated! You’re delivering packages together and you’re going through different hardships together, that’s a given. For example this place, let’s take a look at it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/07d3ef6cc88c66d0863f8560456269e46a2b1859.jpg 

But even though you should respect your truck sometimes having it will also mean having to go through certain problems. In this particular case the guy who told us to come for his stuff asked us to park in a very specific and narrow spot. Well, it’s not the worst place and you can expect many worse places to park in future but nonetheless – it’s easy to cause an accident so let’s be careful! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/18bc1904e62ab85c97dc199f2ee1206dd7407cb6.jpg
 
That will not happen in real life, unfortunately, but in this case we have some technological help – the camera switches to one above us making it a little bit easier for us to park in the designated place. That’s nice, thank you camera man!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/9fcc66be6bbee358a7ad6e4b9894e288aa7515a6.jpg 

And voila! It’s done! Well, actually it’s just the beginning, we just parked but it’s okay to feel a little happy even for the smallest achievements! Anyway, as you can imagine you will see many different challenges during your work as a courier so be mindful and careful!
Thankfully there’s no instructor to rate our parking skills but it won’t hurt to be extra careful!

Fat[EX] Courier Simulator Team

notes.title: Fat[EX] Courier Simulator ~ Devlog #45 "Day and night (and evening too!)"
notes.content:
Hello Couriers! 

”That was a long day…” is what one can say after a particular busy shift. For every day, however, there is a matching night, and for every night another day.

Driving through the city, delivering parcels and boxes all around is a busy and sometimes very dangerous job even if you conduct your activities through the day. Watch dogs, mean customers, terrible weather conditions can make one simple day a true horror to go through. It’s however not the worst if you finish all your tasks before sun goes down…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/67cb5e3821550f891eaca800efc458aac39601ff.jpg
 
But what if it’s already dark outside and you’re still driving around? Frantically looking for that one last person living in a place so complicated to navigate through and not seeing any possibility to make it before night? Or worse – what if someone orders late delivery? Well then, you have to buckle up and be ready for everything – you’ll be cruising through the night. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/ccd8e78d3ce992091f05a8aabf4b15febb7c3530.jpg
 
City might not be too problematic then – after all you have all the lights that are typical for big communities! But what if you had to deliver something to more remote regions? Somewhere where it’s creepy, lonely and sad? You need to be tough enough to do that soldi-- I mean courier!

Be brave my friend! Remember as it happened throughout years – after night there’s always another day!

Best regards,
Fat[EX] Courier Simulator Team

Every journey has to start somewhere – it’s just in the nature of every adventure to have a starting point. In case of our deliveries that would be garage. 

Garage is the place of a unique significance – it’s the safe place where the packages are being stored before they land in our hands. It’s here that you need to go to pick-up the box that the sweet old lady from the neighborhood has ordered and it’s here where an order is waiting to be delivered to a young man in his twenties.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/2efe7682029d6b9e6966aec0271ce808a0a7cdba.png

Garage is safe and in order to get to it you need to manually open the secured gate that is separating the outside world from our storage. Only couriers can access this particular gate and only they can open it letting the car inside. It might be a bit of manual labor that you have to do but as they say – life can be hard. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/e083d8dca23cc8b1c2203273411d5a0223f6fc01.png

After picking up the package you might want to safely put it in your truck, make sure that it will not be damaged during the transportation, close the cargo space and drive off – not quite into the sunset as not all customers live in that direction. You will definitely make someone happy today!

Always remember to check your garage to see if there is an additional package to be delivered sitting in there!

notes.title: Fat[EX] Courier Simulator ~ Devlog #19 ”Physic, how does it work?”
notes.content:
Hello Couriers 

Delivering packages is very challenging and we are here to talk about those challenges!
What do we have to do in order to successfully deliver a package? We must pick it up, load into our truck, get to the right address and then deliver it! Simple as that, right? Wrong! Things are more complicated!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/cf50c97267987dcb3ec7857cde0666f2882ac89e.gif

Today we want to discuss and show you how physics in game is important while driving a loaded truck! That’s right - not only we will have to fight against timers in order to deliver packages - we will have to fight against physics!

Adding more speed to get faster in certain places? Seems a good idea! But what if we will have take sharp turns? How will it end? You can see this in the video below!

As you can see, this is very interesting and entertaining - our truck has rolled and not only we are now slowed down- but we must get back on our feets and start accelerating and once again get enough speed!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/7a5513015ed58c95b2ea2fbf3b01475c0bae9397.jpg

But what is more important - how are packages doing? Are they destroyed? Did our courier do well? Did he get injured? How you would drive? More aggressive or you would be a careful driver? Share your thoughts in the discussion!

Thank you very much for following our work on the game and we hope that soon we will be able to share with you more content implemented in our game. 

Best regards, 
Fat[EX] Courier Simulator team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/904850/FatEX_Courier_Simulator/
